# Roadmap: the shop that changes itself

<!-- Generated by scripts/roadmap.py from docs/roadmap.json. Edit the JSON, then run the script. -->

**The shop that changes itself and demonstrably breaks nothing.** Every stage below reuses the existing core,
private sandboxes and review. A stage counts as working only when it has a
guide and a dated record of what was observed. The [status page](status.md)
stays the record of what is deployed.

| # | Stage | State | What it does | Builds on |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Test customers that attack](customer-scenarios.md#attack-test)** | Works locally ([record](evidence/attack-test-2026-11-18.md)) | Before a change goes live, scripted attackers try forged totals, stale carts, impossible quantities and replayed orders against the private copy. | Customer simulator, private sandboxes, native cart and checkout operations |
| 2 | **[A twin of your existing shop](shop-twin.md)** | Works locally ([record](evidence/shop-twin-2026-11-18.md)) | A private copy shows whether catalog, test stock and checkout are ready, then test customers and attackers try it. Bring the catalog from Shopware, Shopify, WooCommerce or CSV. Nobody has to migrate first. | Migration Assistant, catalog import, customer simulator |
| 3 | **Autopilot levels with a loss limit** | Planned | Choose per area whether an agent suggests, acts within a budget or acts alone. Each level has a daily limit and an automatic rollback. | Existing price autonomy with daily product budget, price corridors, agent credentials with allowances |
| 4 | **Experiments that run themselves** | Planned | An agent states a hypothesis, test customers screen it, a share of real visitors decides, and the result is published or withdrawn. | Existing preregistered layout experiments with consent-bound assignment and payment-ledger readout |
| 5 | **Signed offers for buying agents** | Planned | A buying agent receives a binding quote with a signature it can check, instead of a price it has to trust. | Binding quotes over HTTP, MCP and UCP; short-lived signed native facts |
| 6 | **A trade network between shops** | Planned | Every shop is seller and buyer. A purchasing agent reorders from suppliers within a budget you set. | Read-only supplier catalog import, B2B quotes and negotiation over UCP |
| 7 | **Proof coverage you can read** | Planned | A public page shows which rules are machine-proved, which are tested and which are neither, starting with the money path. | 63 extracted Lean policies, proof manifest, differential checks against original PHP |
| 8 | **Sovereign AI mode** | Planned | One switch keeps every model call on models you host yourself. Studio shows that no shop data leaves your servers. | Local model route, central provider settings, per-task model routing |

## How this page stays current

The stages live in one file, [`docs/roadmap.json`](roadmap.json), in English,
German, French and Spanish. `python3 scripts/roadmap.py` writes this page,
the roadmap line in the README and the data module the website reads.
The required quick check runs `python3 scripts/roadmap.py --check` and fails
when any of them differs from the file, or when a stage claims to work
without a guide and a dated record.
